|errata_history=This is a pre-release (playtest) image of [[Ord Mantell (V)]] (version 1 of 2): the PC published it before Virtual Set 24 was officially released (30 December 2024), so it is not the original (Bill, 12 November 2026: pre-release images are Playtest versions; only the image at official release is the original). The current text is [[Ord Mantell (V)]] (Original). Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Playtest''' (this page): the pre-release card image (26 December 2024)<ref name="ht-3d2c89e">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Dark/large/ordmantell.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual24-Dark/large/ordmantell.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/3d2c89e5f02cee6c39d70bd023260b638f3c0dc1 3d2c89e] “Set 24 New Cards”, 26 December 2024.</ref> prints: “’’’Light Side:’’’ Your smugglers and [Independent] starships deploy -1 here.

’’’Dark Side:’’’ Your [Independent] starships may move here as a ‘react.’ Once per game, if you control, may take Death Mark into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.”<ref name="cj-304ab4f">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/304ab4f swccg-card-json commit 304ab4f] “Set 24” (29 December 2024) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''Original''' ([[Ord Mantell (V)]]): the card image at official release (29 December 2024, 4 days after release)<ref name="ht-3152726">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/31527260ad0ba2742049ae47d245b14317a52e6f/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual24-Dark/large/ordmantell.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual24-Dark/large/ordmantell.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/31527260ad0ba2742049ae47d245b14317a52e6f 3152726] “Ord Mantell rotation fix”, 29 December 2024, 4 days after release.</ref> prints: “’’’Light Side:’’’ Your smugglers and [Independent] starships deploy -1 here.

’’’Dark Side:’’’ Your [Independent] starships may move here as a ‘react.’ Once per game, if you control, may take Death Mark into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” '''What changed:''' The words are unchanged. The card was turned around: the first image prints the Light Side half right way up at the bottom (margin “Ord Mantell (Dark)” at bottom left) and the Dark Side half upside down at the top; the re-made image prints the Dark Side half right way up at the bottom and the Light Side half upside down at the top. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.
